jp: 各神への「信仰の深さ」の上限は「信仰スキル」によって決まります。スキルを成長させるだけでは信仰が深まらないので、必ず祭壇に捧げものをしましょう。

en: The maximum Piety you can have in each god is determined by your faith skill. Simply increasing your skill won't deepen your faith, so be sure to make offerings at the altar.
en_grezzo: "The maximum Piety you can have in each god is determined by your faith skill. Simply increasing your skill won't deepen your faith, so be sure to make offerings at the altar."
it: Il massimo della devozione che puoi avere con ciascun dio dipende dalla tua abilità Fede. Far crescere l'abilità non basta ad approfondire la fede, quindi ricordati di portare offerte all'altare.

jp: 信仰の深さは移動の過程で徐々に減少していくので、定期的に捧げものをしたほうがいいですね。それと、当然ですが信仰の深さは神を乗り換えるとリセットされますよ。
jp_grezzo: "信仰の深さは移動の過程で徐々に減少していくので、定期的に捧げものをしたほうがいいですね。それと、当然ですが信仰の深さは神を乗り換えるとリセットされますよ。"
en: The Piety gradually diminishes during the process of migration, so it's a good idea to make offerings regularly. And, of course, the Piety will be reset if you switch gods.
en_grezzo: "The Piety gradually diminishes during the process of migration, so it's a good idea to make offerings regularly. And, of course, the Piety will be reset if you switch gods."
it: La devozione cala poco alla volta mentre ti sposti, quindi conviene portare offerte con regolarità. E, ovviamente, la devozione si azzera se cambi dio.

jp: 神ごとに好みの捧げものが違います。捧げものを大量に供給できるかどうか、信仰する前によく確認してください。
jp_grezzo: "神ごとに好みの捧げものが違います。捧げものを大量に供給できるかどうか、信仰する前によく確認してください。"

en_grezzo: "Each deity has different preferences for offerings. Before you start faith, make sure you can provide a large quantity of offerings."

jp: 重量のある死体は共通して好まれるので、捧げる目的なら調理しないほうがいいですよ。でも死体の場合は腐ると価値がゴミ同然になるので気をつけてくださいね。
jp_grezzo: "重量のある死体は共通して好まれるので、捧げる目的なら調理しないほうがいいですよ。でも死体の場合は腐ると価値がゴミ同然になるので気をつけてくださいね。"
en: Heavy corpses are generally preferred, so if you're offering one, it's best not to cook it. However, be careful, as corpses become practically worthless once they rot.
en_grezzo: "Heavy corpses are generally preferred, so if you're offering one, it's best not to cook it. However, be careful, as corpses become practically worthless once they rot."
it: I cadaveri pesanti piacciono un po' a tutti, quindi se il tuo scopo è offrirli meglio non cucinarli. Attenzione però: un cadavere che marcisce non vale più niente.

jp: 信仰を深めていくと神ごとに固有の下僕を貰えます。その神の身内などがモデルになっているらしいですね。

en_grezzo: "As your faith deepens, you will receive unique servants from each god. It seems that the servant is modeled after relatives, etc."

jp: さらに信仰を深めていくことで、下僕以上のものも貰えるそうですよ。…信仰を変えてからわざわざ信仰しなおすことで下僕を貰いなおす信者もいますけど、そこまでする必要はあまりないと思います。
jp_grezzo: "さらに信仰を深めていくことで、下僕以上のものも貰えるそうですよ。…信仰を変えてからわざわざ信仰しなおすことで下僕を貰いなおす信者もいますけど、そこまでする必要はあまりないと思います。"
en: They say that by deepening your faith even further, you can receive more than just a servant... Some believers even change their faith and then change it again just to receive a servant again, but I don't think it's really necessary to go that far.
en_grezzo: "They say that by deepening your faith even further, you can receive more than just a servant... Some believers even change their faith and then change it again just to receive a servant again, but I don't think it's really necessary to go that far."
it: Approfondendo ancora la fede, dicono che si riceva anche più di un'incarnazione... C'è pure chi cambia dio e poi torna indietro apposta per farsene dare un'altra, ma non credo valga la pena arrivare a tanto.

jp: あの本は…皆に確認したけれど、誰も知らないみたいです。ある日、気づいたら出現していました。
jp_grezzo: "あの本は…皆に確認したけれど、誰も知らないみたいです。ある日、気づいたら出現していました。"
en: That book… I confirmed with everyone, but it seems no one knows about it. It suddenly appeared one day.
en_grezzo: "That book… I confirmed with everyone, but it seems no one knows about it. It suddenly appeared one day."
it: Quel libro... ho chiesto a tutti, ma nessuno pare saperne niente. Un giorno era lì, all'improvviso.

jp: 得体のしれない魔道具のようですが、一流の冒険者はきっとあんなものでも使いこなせるんでしょうね…。
jp_grezzo: "得体のしれない魔道具のようですが、一流の冒険者はきっとあんなものでも使いこなせるんでしょうね…。"
en: Though its nature is unclear, it appears to be some mysterious magical artifact of some kind… A top-tier adventurer could likely wield even such an object with ease.
en_grezzo: "Though its nature is unclear, it appears to be some mysterious magical artifact of some kind… A top-tier adventurer could likely wield even such an object with ease."
it: Sembra un oggetto magico dalla natura oscura, ma un avventuriero di prim'ordine saprebbe di sicuro come usare perfino una cosa del genere...

jp: この街が人狼どもの餌場になるくらいなら、狐に支配されたほうが幸せじゃろう？
jp_grezzo: "この街が人狼どもの餌場になるくらいなら、狐に支配されたほうが幸せじゃろう？"
en: Wouldn't it be better for this town to be ruled by foxes than to become a feeding ground for werewolves?
en_grezzo: "Wouldn't it be better for this town to be ruled by foxes than to become a feeding ground for werewolves?"
it: Meglio una città governata dalle volpi che una città ridotta a pascolo dei lupi mannari, non credi?

jp: 油揚げをお供えする
jp_grezzo: "油揚げをお供えする"
en: Here, have some fried tofu.
en_grezzo: "Here, have some fried tofu."
it: Offrire il tofu fritto

jp: 今度持ってきます
jp_grezzo: "今度持ってきます"
en: I'll bring it next time.
en_grezzo: "I'll bring it next time."
it: Lo porto un'altra volta

jp: この街はわしの支配下にあるぞ。ほれほれ、崇め奉るがよい。そして、わしに油揚げを献上するのじゃ。
jp_grezzo: "この街はわしの支配下にあるぞ。ほれほれ、崇め奉るがよい。そして、わしに油揚げを献上するのじゃ。"
en: This city is under my control. Come on, worship me. Gimme some fried tofu.
en_grezzo: "This city is under my control. Come on, worship me. Gimme some fried tofu."
it: Questa città è sotto il mio dominio. Su, su, adorami come si conviene. E portami il tofu fritto in offerta.

jp: やったぁー！…コホン。褒美をくれてやろう、有効活用するがよい。そして、油揚げを手に入れたらまた献上するのじゃ。
jp_grezzo: "やったぁー！…コホン。褒美をくれてやろう、有効活用するがよい。そして、油揚げを手に入れたらまた献上するのじゃ。"
en: Yay!...Oops. Offer it to me as many times as you like. I'll give you a reward, so make good use of it. Return to me when you've got more tofu in your pockets.
en_grezzo: "Yay!...Oops. Offer it to me as many times as you like. I'll give you a reward, so make good use of it. Return to me when you've got more tofu in your pockets."
it: Evviva! ...Ehm. Offrimene quanto ti pare. Ti darò una ricompensa, fanne buon uso. E torna da me quando avrai altro tofu in tasca.

jp: 用意の悪いやつじゃのう。油揚げを常備しておらんのか？
jp_grezzo: "用意の悪いやつじゃのう。油揚げを常備しておらんのか？"
en: Ah, what a pity. It's common sense to have tofus in your pockets you know?
en_grezzo: "Ah, what a pity. It's common sense to have tofus in your pockets you know?"
it: Ah, che peccato. Un po' di tofu fritto in tasca si tiene sempre, lo sai, no?

jp: やだなぁ…隙を見て赤ちゃんをさらおうなんて考えてませんよぉ。
jp_grezzo: "やだなぁ…隙を見て赤ちゃんをさらおうなんて考えてませんよぉ。"
en: No...I'm not thinking of stealing the baby while looking for a chance...
en_grezzo: "No...I'm not thinking of stealing the baby while looking for a chance..."
it: Ma no... non sto mica aspettando il momento buono per portare via il bambino, eh...

jp: あー…子供ができない夫婦のとこに赤ちゃん届けてチヤホヤされてぇ…。
jp_grezzo: "あー…子供ができない夫婦のとこに赤ちゃん届けてチヤホヤされてぇ…。"
en: Ah...I want to deliver a baby to a couple who can't have children...
en_grezzo: "Ah...I want to deliver a baby to a couple who can't have children..."
it: Ah... vorrei tanto portare un bambino a una coppia che non può averne, e farmi coccolare...

jp: 子育てってノイローゼになるくらい大変ですよ。私が預かりましょうか？
jp_grezzo: "子育てってノイローゼになるくらい大変ですよ。私が預かりましょうか？"
en: Parenting is so hard that it makes me have a nervous breakdown. Shall I take care of the baby?
en_grezzo: "Parenting is so hard that it makes me have a nervous breakdown. Shall I take care of the baby?"
it: Crescere un figlio è così faticoso da far venire l'esaurimento. Vuole che me ne occupi io?
